edit.description: `clauseRow`'s `when` branch (80-111) builds the guard's own row by recursion (90) and then hand-lists eleven argument columns off it — `field`, `value_type`, `shape`, `bound`, `unit`, `charset`, `keys`, `values`, `range`, `section`, `sections` — while omitting `count`, `target`, `degree`, `fields` and `gate`. The list is a partial enumeration of the row's argument columns, maintained by discipline: a column added to `ClauseRow` for a guardable predicate reaches a plain clause's row and silently misses a guard's. Replace it with one spelling that cannot omit a column — the guard row's columns ride through, with the `when` clause's own seven (`kind`, `predicate: "when"`, `severity`, `guidance`, `cite`, `guard_predicate`, `body`) set over them. The Rust reader is the total counterpart to mirror: `contract.rs`'s `predicate_from_row` rebuilds the guard as `ClauseRow { predicate, field, value_type, values, ..row.clone() }` (769-776). Seam bytes are unchanged — `JSON.stringify` drops `undefined`-valued keys, so the five newly-carried columns write nothing. `sdk/tsconfig.json` sets no `noUnusedLocals`, so the rest-destructure omit idiom compiles under `strict`. The two comments at 80 and 88 paraphrase the copy the fold deletes and go with it (`engineering.md`, "Narration is the ladder's bottom rung"); the bare `throw new Error("when clause missing guard predicate")` (85) picks up the spec cite every other refusal in the file carries.

The `when` round-trip test (500-525) pins an `enum` guard's `values`; add the `type`-guard arm beside it so the column a `type` guard spells (`value_type`) is pinned too — the assertion a dropped column breaks. Both assert per column rather than whole-row, so the key set `sdk/test/common.ts`'s base fixture contracts is untouched by the spread.

summary: clauseRow's `when` branch hand-copies eleven of the guard row's argument columns where the engine's reader spreads the whole row; one spelling replaces the maintained list.

per.section: A shared concept is one type

tests.asserts: a `when` row carries its guard's `guard_predicate` plus that guard's own argument column — `values` for an `enum` guard, `value_type` for a `type` guard — and its body rows unchanged
the live SDK emit still byte-matches the embedded lock — the clause family rides this lowering

acceptance: `pnpm --dir sdk test` and `cargo test` green; `declarations.ts` names no per-column list in the `when` branch, and the emitted clause rows are byte-identical (the five newly-carried columns are `undefined`, which `JSON.stringify` drops).
notes: Found by the posture sweep of the emit neighborhood. No live defect today: the guard vocabulary is `type`/`enum` (`contract.ts`'s `when`), whose columns the list does carry, and an inadmissible guard fails loud at lock read (`compose::clause_from_row`'s `ClauseRowError::Predicate`). What is fileable is the shape — the writer hand-enumerates where the reader spreads. scoped at d6b5744f
